subject.title: [Feature]: Multi-role support in Chat UI for multi-agent workflows

question: What durable sender identity contract should OpenClaw expose for multi-agent chat messages across Gateway RPCs, transcripts, live events, and Control UI rendering?
rationale: Current main has partial sender-label projection, but choosing id/kind/name/avatar/color fields and persistence/API semantics is a public product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Design additive sender metadata
options.body: Define and persist per-message sender id, kind, display name, source session/agent, and render hints, then render it in Control UI while keeping existing provenance for model-safety context.

options.title: Keep label-only behavior
options.body: Treat current senderLabel and Forwarded from agent-id projection as sufficient and close the broader durable identity request.

options.title: Split narrower bugs
options.body: Defer this broad feature and handle only the specific sessions_send prompt and WebChat fallback reports in their linked issues.

recommendation.title: Design additive sender metadata
recommendation.body: Define and persist per-message sender id, kind, display name, source session/agent, and render hints, then render it in Control UI while keeping existing provenance for model-safety context.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combination of prior review ownership and recent inter-session provenance work touching the public contract boundary.
